research_summary: A precisely timestamped pre-deadline report says Muñoz requires surgery and is not expected back before 17 January. This is a high-confidence availability correction for an owned player.

sources.title: Fantasy Premier League Gameweek 16: Forbløffende trender og avgjørende kapteinsvalg
sources.citation_excerpt: Onsdag kom altså nyheten om at Munoz må opereres og er ikke forventet tilbake før 17. januar.
sources.claim_text: Daniel Muñoz required surgery and was not expected to return before 17 January.
